integrity: Complete algebraic argument included. Primary preprint and related paper read directly; publisher final text only abstract-accessible. No independent audit or validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted simple complete bipartite graphs and ordinary adjacency Hamiltonian only. All start vertices must share one observation-time law. The four positive cases were known; the new content excludes every other biclique and gives a non-optimal quantitative gap for the four-leaf star. Finite checking does not establish the unrestricted theorem.
title: Uniform randomized-time mixing on complete bipartite quantum walks
